scenes.title: When the Saints
scenes.subtitle: G, C and D, upbeat.
lines: This lesson teaches the upbeat song 'When the Saints', using only the G, C and D chords.
You'll play it confidently after a few practice runs.
Let's play 'When the Saints Go Marching In'.
The chords are G, D and C.
The tempo is 100 beats per minute, four beats per bar.

points: Play When the Saints Go Marching In
lines: You're all set to play 'When the Saints' with the chords we've learned.
Let's play along while the app listens and gives you feedback.
